name: OMathFrac
description: Represents a fraction, consisting of a numerator and denominator separated by a fraction bar. The fraction bar can be horizontal or diagonal, depending on the fraction properties.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathFrac object.

properties.name: Num
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the numerator for a fraction. Read-only.

properties.name: Den
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the denominator for an equation that contains a fraction. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathFracType constant that represents the layout of a fraction, whether it is stacked, skewed, linear, or without a fraction bar. Read/write.
